title: Deadpan Helpful-Answer Ad
source: 2026 award-winning AI-assistant spot: gym trainer's advice turns into an ad read
description: A locked-off deadpan two-hander: a user asks an expert for help, the expert's friendly answer slides into an absurd product pitch, then the music hits under two plain supers and an end card.
prompt30: Make a 30 s deadpan spot for our privacy-first email app: a stressed intern asks the office IT guy how to reach inbox zero fast, his friendly answer slides into a pitch for a 'focus crystal' with a promo code, then 'There is a time and place for tracking.' / 'Your inbox should not be one of them.' and our end card.
